$comment: INT-3701 cooling water intake twin (fine band screen + CW pump). Expected values in Maximo Monitor from the screen and pump data sheets and the intake drawings; the device sends only what it measures.

twin.name: Cooling water intake line A INT-3701

identification.model: Band Screen DiscMax + SEZ circulating water pump
identification.description: Seawater cooling water intake line A: fine band screen with spray wash and circulating water pump CWP-A
identification.screen: HUBER Band Screen DiscMax: direct-flow fine band screen, crescent-shaped screen elements on a central chain, spray nozzle bar behind the elements, launder
identification.pump: KSB SEZ: vertical tubular casing pump with open mixed-flow impeller (circulating water pump CWP-A)
identification.plant: Coastal combined-cycle power plant, once-through seawater cooling, two CW lines (A and B), one per screen and pump

screen.source: maker_range: HUBER Band Screen DiscMax brochure and product page. Channel width 3.5 m (the largest DiscMax channel), effective screen width, 3 mm mesh, open area fraction, clean head loss 0.05 m at 5.0 m3/s and 6.5 m water depth, running speeds, the differential at which the screen goes to high speed and the drive torque line: assumption: typical value, replace with your screen supplier's hydraulic data sheet

wash.source: Spray-wash header pressure and flow at the design point, and the wash pump shut-off pressure: assumption: typical value, replace with your wash pump curve and nozzle data

pump.source: maker_range: KSB SEZ product page. Duty point 5.0 m3/s (18,000 m3/h) at 18 m, shut-off head, best efficiency, suction bell outside diameter, bell height above the floor and pressure gauge elevation above the channel invert: assumption: typical value, replace with your pump test curve and general arrangement drawing

intake.source: Levels are metres above the screen channel invert. Seawater density, mean sea level, tidal range (one semi-diurnal tide of 12.42 h), intake culvert head loss and condenser waterbox pressure drop at the duty flow, and the highest seawater temperature the condenser was sized for: assumption: typical value, replace with your intake drawings, tide tables and condenser data sheet

demo.note: Demo only: the plant clock runs 60 times faster, so one tide (12.42 h) takes about 12 minutes of real time.

points.label: Sea level at the intake mouth (tide gauge)
Water level upstream of the screen
Water level in the pump bay (downstream of the screen)
Hours at high speed, last 24 h
CW flow of line A (ultrasonic flowmeter)
CW pump top bearing vibration velocity
Condenser waterbox differential pressure, line A

limits.source: Alarm levels: assumption: typical value, replace with your intake operating philosophy. Submergence margin 1.0 = the ANSI/HI 9.8 minimum submergence.

failure_modes.$comment: Each failure mode: what degrades, how it shows, the rules that see it.

debris_surge.name: Debris or jellyfish surge on the screen
debris_surge.symptoms: screen differential rises fast at the same flow, pump bay level falls, screen at high speed

mesh_biofouling.name: Biofouling of the mesh (growth the spray does not remove)
mesh_biofouling.symptoms: moderate blinding that stays, screen at high speed most of the day

spray_nozzle_blockage.name: Spray nozzles blocked
spray_nozzle_blockage.symptoms: wash pressure up, wash flow down

wash_pump_wear.name: Spray-wash pump worn
wash_pump_wear.symptoms: wash pressure and flow both down along the nozzle line

drive_chain_wear.name: Chain, guide or drive wear (screen getting stiff)
drive_chain_wear.symptoms: drive torque above the line for this differential

seal_carryover.name: Screen seal or element damaged: debris carried over
seal_carryover.symptoms: differential far below clean, condenser waterbox pressure drop rises

cw_pump_wear.name: CW pump impeller or wear ring wear
cw_pump_wear.symptoms: head and efficiency below the curve at the measured flow

culvert_fouling.name: Intake culvert fouling or silting (low pump bay level)
culvert_fouling.symptoms: level lost between sea and screen, pump bay low, submergence below the HI 9.8 minimum, vibration
